out.title: ICRA reaffirms AAA/Stable rating; assigns to Rs 50,000 crore bank loans
out.summary: ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]AAA/Stable on Rs 12,000 crore NCDs and A1+ on Rs 10,000 crore commercial paper, and assigned AAA/Stable to new Rs 50,000 crore bank loan facilities; letter received October 21, 2026.
